title: Fuel
content: A fuel is a substance that releases sufficient energy to do work as it undergoes a chemical change.

title: Hydrocarbon
content: Hydrocarbon is any of a class of organic chemical compounds composed only of the elements carbon (C) and hydrogen (H).

title: Catalytic cracking
content: Catalytic cracking is a process used to split long chain alkanes into shorter alkanes and alkenes in the presence of catalyst under pressure and high temperature.

title: Transesterification
content: Transesterification is the process of exchanging the alkoxy group of an ester compound by another alcohol.

title: Octane rating
content: Octane rating (octane number) is a measure of a fuel's ability to resist 'knock'.
